title: Open en bloot 1974
descriptions: Evaluation of public reaction to one of a series tv programs on sexual education. Exposure to and opinions on tv-program about venereal diseases in a series called 'open en bloot' / attitude to sexual matters / sex instruction when young / information on venereal diseases / information on how one can get such a disease. Background variables: basic characteristics/ household characteristics/ education/ social class/ religion
